asset.title: Live Create Export Reload
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser benchmark proof clip. Judge only visible product behavior: fresh-room flow, uploads, public NodeAgent invocation, streaming/tool traces, focus/attention UI, artifact creation/download, and production honesty. Clip duration, silence, or README pacing is not a product defect.

judge.summary: The video successfully demonstrates the end-to-end flow of entering a room from the landing page, navigating sheets, exporting data to XLSX, and reloading the workspace to verify state persistence.

featureClarity.evidence: Demonstrates room entry, sheet navigation, XLSX export, and page reload clearly.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the complete sequence from the landing page to active workspace interaction and reload.

visualDesign.evidence: Maintains a consistent dark-mode aesthetic with high-density data layouts, though skeleton transitions are slightly abrupt.

consistency.evidence: Aligns with the established NodeRoom design system, featuring spreadsheets, agent logs, and chat sidebars.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Captured from a live browser session showing authentic UI interactions and loading states.

legibility.evidence: Text and numbers in the spreadsheet cells are readable, though dense.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant for demonstrating data export and workspace persistence to technical and business users.

productionHonesty.evidence: Accurately depicts loading skeletons and the actual reload behavior of the application.

observedEvidence: Landing page with live demo widget
Page reload and skeleton loading state

defects.observed: After reloading, the active sheet resets to 'Company research' instead of preserving the user's previous selection of 'Q3 variance'.
defects.fix: Preserve the active sheet state in the URL or local storage across reloads.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch the seamless flow of entering a NodeRoom, exporting financial sheets to XLSX, and reloading the workspace with full state integrity.
